cd /c/visual\ projects/alpha; cat > tools/compute/tk393-starknet-filter.py <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TK-393: фильтр свопов Ekubo по 5 пулам STRK (ключ token0-token1-fee-tick_spacing-ext) -> <out>/swaps_pools.csv + сводка по пулу.
usage: tk393-starknet-filter.py <swaps.csv> <out.csv>  (пулы — аргументом POOLS через запятую)"""
import csv, sys, os
src, dst = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
want = {}
for p in os.environ["POOLS"].split(","):
    a, b, f, ts, e = p.split("-")
    want[(int(a, 16), int(b, 16), int(f), int(ts), int(e, 16))] = p
cnt = {}
with open(src) as fi, open(dst, "w", newline="") as fo:
    r = csv.reader(fi); h = next(r); w = csv.writer(fo); w.writerow(h + ["pool"])
    for x in r:
        k = (int(x[2], 16), int(x[3], 16), int(x[4], 16), int(x[5]), int(x[6], 16))
        p = want.get(k)
        if p:
            w.writerow(x + [p]); cnt[p] = cnt.get(p, 0) + 1
for p, n in cnt.items(): print(n, p[:30], p[-60:])
print("total", sum(cnt.values()), "pools_hit", len(cnt), "of", len(want))
EOF
POOLS=$(grep -i -h '^STRK,starknet' data/tk393/nochain-pools.csv | cut -d, -f3 | paste -sd,)
echo "$POOLS" | tr ',' '\n' | wc -l
scp -q tools/compute/tk393-starknet-filter.py calc:/data/tk0393/ && ssh calc "POOLS='$POOLS' systemd-run --quiet --wait --pipe --collect -p CPUQuota=100% -E POOLS='$POOLS' python3 /data/tk0393/tk393-starknet-filter.py /data/tk0393/sqd7/stk/swaps.csv /data/tk0393/sqd7/stk/swaps_pools.csv" 2>&1 | tail -10
